scope.family: G = complement of s C3 disjoint-union t C4

method.coordinate_formula: SHA256('win-00065-p04|s|t|trial|v|j') first 8 bytes big-endian, reduced modulo 2001, then minus 1000
method.vertex_order: all C3 components first, then C4 components; consecutive vertices; cyclic forbidden edges
method.edge_order: lexicographic pairs (u,v), u<v, excluding cycle edges
method.interpretation: full affine rank mod p and rigidity rank r mod p certify affine spanning and exact rational rigidity rank r for the integer placement; a nonzero stored determinant mod p certifies a nonzero integer maximal minor
